content.text: About Ladder7: an Indian software engineering partner for global teams.

Ladder7 NextStep Solutions is a software development company with teams in Kochi and Trivandrum, Kerala. Enterprise architects, engineers, data scientists and transformation specialists build software for clients in the UAE, the UK (London), Germany, Ireland, the USA, Singapore, Australia, Vietnam and India.
